points.quote: `workbench.desktop.main.ts` and `workbench.web.main.ts` each start with `import './workbench.common.main.js'`. They then add their own platform-specific imports and service registrations.
The web file, for example, adds `contrib/webview/browser/webview.web.contribution.js` and `contrib/extensions/browser/extensions.web.contribution.js`.
`src/vs/workbench/workbench.common.main.ts` is the shared entry point. ... each start with `import './workbench.common.main.js'`.
a shared feature can only reach platform-specific behaviour through a service interface that each platform implements.
"Only code referenced from entry point files is loaded." ... If no entry point reaches a file, it is never bundled or loaded.
A feature's `*.contribution.ts` file registers its services, commands, views and so on when it is imported.
